training_people: Complete four-profile high/low people outside ALL existing main and pilot candidates
target: Unchanged locked main high/low people and recipient tasks
recipient_coding: Canonical LEVELS reference-coded intercept plus all eight recorded recipient factors
income_coding: Canonical recipient basis fully interacted with observed low versus high respondent household income
other_respondent_facts: Not used; employment risk and parenthood are outside these fixed simple references
fit: Ordinary least squares by SVD; require full column rank; no regularization or hyperparameter search
predictions: Continuous conditional-mean predictions clipped to [0,4000]; no integer rounding, sampling or invented trajectories

cross_validation.split: Shuffle sorted person IDs separately within high/low strata, array_split into five folds; all four rows stay together
cross_validation.purpose: Report out-of-fold RMSE and MAE for all references; never select a reference or tune settings

main_reporting: All three references on identical locked rows; both component contrasts and moderation, same-output diagnostics, RMSE and MAE; no model winner selection
information_access: Human allocation labels from training people, unlike the planned sparse-context LLM arms; no equal-information superiority claim
main_outcome_access: Only separate evaluation may read target labels; prediction must not depend on them
